# Daro's Enclave

> A quiet long-stay residency for writers, researchers and remote workers, in an ancestral home in Kamburugamuwa, between Mirissa and Madiha on Sri Lanka's south coast.

Daro's Enclave is a family ancestral home at 229/A, Egodawaththa, Kamburugamuwa, Sri Lanka. It is offered as a whole-house residency: one resident or household at a time, for stays of one to six months. It is not a hotel and not a retreat programme.

## Key facts

- Location: Kamburugamuwa, on Sri Lanka's south coast, 3 km from Mirissa and 2 km from Madiha. Kamburugamuwa beach is a 600-metre walk.
- Stays: one to six months, as stated on https://www.darosenclave.com/residency
- Fee: US$575 per month, including utilities: fibre internet, gas for cooking, electricity and water
- Internet: SLT fibre Unlimited Home Plus, 200 Mbps down / 100 Mbps up package/plan speed, best-effort (not a measured speed-test figure). Wi-Fi across the house, included in the residency fee
- Contact: darosenclave@gmail.com, +94 76 748 8404 (call or WhatsApp)
